prompt:
“Where the Light Lands” — 60s

Look/Style: Cinematic tropical romance, golden hour → lavender-blue dusk, warm coral/peach tones, soft lens flare, shallow DOF, subtle film grain. Mix drone wides, handheld close-ups, static shots, slow push-ins, slow-motion nature inserts, and Polaroid viewfinder POV. Playful, intimate, natural chemistry.

Characters:
A — dark wavy hair, cream linen shirt over swimsuit, tote bag, Polaroid camera.
B — sandy-brown hair, open faded denim shirt, swim trunks, soft-top paddleboard.

Setting: Quiet tropical cove with turquoise water, driftwood, tide pools and palms → cozy open-air juice shack with string lights.

TIMELINE

0–2s: Title “Where the Light Lands” over sandals and beach bag, ocean behind.

2–6s: B paddles across calm turquoise water.
6–8s: Slow-motion wave reaches shore.
8–10s: Paddleboard foreground, B distant in water.
10–12s: A watches B approach from shore.
12–14s: A sits on driftwood, camera in lap.
14–16s: A photographs B laughing as he comes ashore.
16–18s: Macro: photo prints from camera.
18–20s: Viewfinder POV of B approaching with a grin.
20–22s: A fans the developing photo.

22–24s: B: “Let me see how bad it is.”
24–26s: A: “It’s actually really good.”
26–28s: B: “That’s exactly what someone with a bad picture says.”
28–30s: A hands him the photo.
30–32s: B studies it, smiling.
32–34s: B: “…I’m keeping this one.”

34–36s: Hermit crab crosses wet sand.
36–38s: Empty cove, gentle waves.

38–40s: Juice shack lights switch on; A joins B.
40–42s: B: “You always order the same thing, you know that?”
42–44s: A sits beside him.
44–46s: B waits for her response.
46–48s: A: “Why fix what isn’t broken?”
48–50s: Drinks arrive; warm string lights glow.
50–52s: They laugh, shoulders touching.

52–54s: Drone shot over ocean at dusk.
54–56s: Golden reflections in tide pool.
56–58s: Foam washes over footprints.
58–60s: String lights sway against lavender-blue sky. Fade out.

promptTranslations.zh:
“Where the Light Lands” — 60秒

外观/风格：电影感热带浪漫风格，黄金时刻 → 薰衣草蓝黄昏，温暖的珊瑚/桃色调，柔和镜头光晕，浅景深，微弱胶片颗粒感。融合无人机航拍全景、手持特写、固定镜头、缓慢推镜头、慢动作自然特写空镜以及拍立得取景器第一视角（POV）。俏皮、亲密且自然的默契互动。

角色：
A — 深色微卷发，泳装外穿米白色亚麻衬衫，托特包，拍立得相机。
B — 沙褐色头发，敞开的褪色牛仔衬衫，泳裤，软顶桨板。

场景：宁静的热带海湾，有碧绿的海水、浮木、潮汐池和棕榈树 → 挂着串灯的温馨露天果汁吧。

时间线

0–2秒：标题“Where the Light Lands”浮现于凉鞋和沙滩包上方，背景为大海。

2–6秒：B划着桨板穿过平静的碧绿水面。
6–8秒：慢动作海浪拍打上岸。
8–10秒：前景为桨板，B在远处的涉水区。
10–12秒：A在岸边注视着B靠近。
12–14秒：A坐在浮木上，相机放在膝头。
14–16秒：A拍下B上岸时大笑的样子。
16–18秒：微距：照片从相机中缓缓打印出。
18–20秒：取景器POV：B带着笑容走近。
20–22秒：A轻轻扇动正在显影的照片。

22–24秒：B：“让我看看有多难看。”
24–26秒：A：“其实拍得特别好。”
26–28秒：B：“拍砸了的人都是这么说的。”
28–30秒：A把照片递给他。
30–32秒：B端详着照片，笑了。
32–34秒：B：“……这张我留着了。”

34–36秒：寄居蟹穿过湿润的沙滩。
36–38秒：空无一人的海湾，微风细浪。

38–40秒：果汁吧的彩灯亮起；A走向B身旁。
40–42秒：B：“你每次点的都一模一样，你自己知道吗？”
42–44秒：A在他身旁坐下。
44–46秒：B等待她的回应。
46–48秒：A：“好好的东西干嘛要变呢？”
48–50秒：饮品送达；温暖的串灯泛着光晕。
50–52秒：他们相视而笑，肩膀相触。

52–54秒：黄昏时分大海上方无人机航拍镜头。
54–56秒：潮汐池中倒映着金色余晖。
56–58秒：泡沫拂过沙滩上的脚印。
58–60秒：串灯在薰衣草蓝色的夜空下轻晃。淡出。

B — sandy-brown hair, open faded denim shirt, swim trunks, soft-top paddleboard.

A — 深色波浪卷发，泳衣外搭米色亚麻衬衫，托特包，拍立得相机。
B — 浅棕色头发，敞开的褪色牛仔衬衫，泳裤，软顶桨板。

场景：宁静的热带海湾，清澈碧水、沉木、潮汐池与棕榈树 → 挂着串灯的惬意露天果汁摊。

时间线：
0–2秒：片名“Where the Light Lands”浮现于凉鞋与沙滩包上方，背景为大海。
2–6秒：B在平静的碧蓝海面上划桨板。
6–8秒：慢动作海浪涌向沙滩。
8–10秒：前景为桨板，远处海中为B。
10–12秒：A在岸边注视B靠近。
12–14秒：A坐在沉木上，膝上放着相机。
14–16秒：A拍下笑着走上岸的B。
16–18秒：微距：照片从相机吐出。
18–20秒：取景框主观视角，B带着笑容走来。
20–22秒：A甩动显影中的照片。
22–24秒：B：“让我看看拍得有多烂。”
24–26秒：A：“其实拍得特别好。”
26–28秒：B：“拍砸了的人都这么说。”
28–30秒：A把照片递给他。
30–32秒：B微笑着端详照片。
32–34秒：B：“……这张归我了。”
34–36秒：寄居蟹爬过湿润沙滩。
36–38秒：空旷海湾，微浪轻涌。
38–40秒：果汁摊串灯亮起；A走向B。
40–42秒：B：“你每次都点一样的，知道吗？”
42–44秒：A坐到他身旁。
44–46秒：B等待她的回答。
46–48秒：A：“好好的为什么要改？”
48–50秒：饮品送达；温暖串灯闪烁。
50–52秒：两人欢笑，肩膀相碰。
52–54秒：黄昏海面的无人机航拍俯瞰。
54–56秒：潮汐池中倒映金色余晖。
56–58秒：泡沫拂过脚印。
58–60秒：串灯在蓝紫色天幕下轻摇。淡出。
translations.en:
“Where the Light Lands” — 60s

Look/Style: Cinematic tropical romance, golden hour → lavender-blue dusk, warm coral/peach tones, soft lens flare, shallow DOF, subtle film grain. Mix drone wides, handheld close-ups, static shots, slow push-ins, slow-motion nature inserts, and Polaroid viewfinder POV. Playful, intimate, natural chemistry.

Characters:
A — dark wavy hair, cream linen shirt over swimsuit, tote bag, Polaroid camera.
B — sandy-brown hair, open faded denim shirt, swim trunks, soft-top paddleboard.

Setting: Quiet tropical cove with turquoise water, driftwood, tide pools and palms → cozy open-air juice shack with string lights.

TIMELINE

0–2s: Title “Where the Light Lands” over sandals and beach bag, ocean behind.

2–6s: B paddles across calm turquoise water.
6–8s: Slow-motion wave reaches shore.
8–10s: Paddleboard foreground, B distant in water.
10–12s: A watches B approach from shore.
12–14s: A sits on driftwood, camera in lap.
14–16s: A photographs B laughing as he comes ashore.
16–18s: Macro: photo prints from camera.
18–20s: Viewfinder POV of B approaching with a grin.
20–22s: A fans the developing photo.

22–24s: B: “Let me see how bad it is.”
24–26s: A: “It’s actually really good.”
26–28s: B: “That’s exactly what someone with a bad picture says.”
28–30s: A hands him the photo.
30–32s: B studies it, smiling.
32–34s: B: “…I’m keeping this one.”

34–36s: Hermit crab crosses wet sand.
36–38s: Empty cove, gentle waves.

38–40s: Juice shack lights switch on; A joins B.
40–42s: B: “You always order the same thing, you know that?”
42–44s: A sits beside him.
44–46s: B waits for her response.
46–48s: A: “Why fix what isn’t broken?”
48–50s: Drinks arrive; warm string lights glow.
50–52s: They laugh, shoulders touching.

52–54s: Drone shot over ocean at dusk.
54–56s: Golden reflections in tide pool.
56–58s: Foam washes over footprints.
58–60s: String lights sway against lavender-blue sky. Fade out.
